abhissanna.p: [Abhi+sanna+ta.(abhisyanda-saṃ)] (ti) CL=7 flow away (a) Wet; full,saturated diffused (B) very-intense-vehement. Having -very -intense-vehement -in all three kinds of anger , air anger, bile anger, and phlegm anger. (B) see also  Abhisannakāya-abhissanna(ti) [abhi+sanda+ta] trickle,flow and permeate,infiltrate. Come in contact with and diffuse.. See Abhishanna:
